---
title: "02 · Clinical Interpretation — Phase 2 Dose Range"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr)
source(here("R", "helpers.R"))
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

**Conclusion:** AUC~0-24~ was identified as the best exposure metric for the
continuous biomarker (lowest AIC). The estimated EC₅₀ was within 20% of the
true value (2.5 mg/L), demonstrating good identifiability with the simulated
study design.

The recommended Phase 2 dose range is 100–300 mg QD. At 100 mg, the
population-median predicted effect reaches approximately 55% of E~max~,
sufficient to establish activity. At 300 mg, > 80% of patients are predicted
to exceed 75% E~max~. Doses above 400 mg provide diminishing marginal effect
given the sigmoid shape of the ER relationship.
